finding.title: Buffer Overflow or Out-of-bounds Write
finding.trigger: address is outside the valid range of PPU registers
finding.assumptions: The function does not validate that 'address' is within the valid range of PPU registers. If an attacker can control the 'address' parameter, they could write to arbitrary memory locations.

parsed.change_summary: Added address range validation in the write and read functions to ensure that the address is within the valid range of PPU registers.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the write and read functions now include a check to ensure that the address is within the valid range of PPU registers (from INIDISP to WMADDX). If the address is outside this range, the functions will not perform the write or read operation, thus preventing out-of-bounds access.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Tried to locate a bounds check or constant argument; none found. No unreachable path or dead code. The write/read functions directly dereference the address without validation.
